summary: The agent failed because it wrote datetime objects (with time component 00:00:00) to Excel date columns, but the verifier expected date objects (date only). The agent dismissed this verification error as a 'script issue' rather than fixing it. Updated production-planning/SKILL.md to explicitly require date objects (not datetime) for date columns, added troubleshooting for this exact failure mode, and strengthened guidance on treating verifier mismatches as real issues.
